newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OLYMPICS-KITZBUEHEL CONSIDERS 2006 WINTER GAMES BID.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-KITZBUEHEL CONSIDERS 2006 WINTER GAMES BID.

text.p: The Austrian resort of Kitzbuehel, famous for the Alpine ski World Cup's most demanding downhill, is considering a bid to host the Winter Olympics in 2006.

The Austrian news agency APA reported on Saturday that a Kitzbuehel committee will meet politicians of Austria's western province of Tyrol next week. Austria's southern province of Carinthia has already presented a bid for the Games.
The International Olympic Committee will decide the host in 1999.
